### `POST /api/v4/assignments/candidates` — Adds a person as a candidate to an assignment.
operationId: `v4.v4.assignments.candidates.store`

**Body** (`application/json`, required) — `api.v2.person.candidatesUpdateRequest`

| field | type | req | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `assignmentId` | integer |  | The ID of an assignment to add the candidates to. |
| `assignmentName` | string |  | Can be used instead of `assignmentId` and will search for an assignment with the name or create if it doesn't exist. |
| `candidates` | integer[] |  | An array of person IDs that will be added to the assignment. |

**Responses:** `200` → `api.person.candidatesUpdateResponse` · `404` — The people or the assignment cannot be found.
